To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the elderly hearing-impaired persons who are task-oriented perceive less handicap from their hearing loss than the elderly hearing-imaired persons who are low on task- orientation.
elderly hearing-impaired persons who are high on task- orientation reported significantly less handicap at three months than those who were low on task- orientation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between task-orientation and perceived handicap in hearing-impaired elderly persons.
the relationship between task-orientation, perceived benefit of amplification and the reported handicap of hearing-impaired elderly persons.
the effects of hearing impairment in elderly persons and their reactions to the use of hearing aids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

elderly hearing-impaired persons who were high on task- orientation reported significantly less handicap with their amplification than did elderly hearing-impaired subjects who were low on task- orientation.
elderly hearing-impaired subjects who are task-oriented are likely to report a less severe handicap than subjects classified low on task- orientation.
task-orientation does not seem to be a factor in the perceived handicap of hearing-impaired elderly patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
task-oriented persons have a greater ability to adapt to the stress of hearing loss than do less task-oriented persons.
elderly hearing-impaired persons who are high in task-orientation are more likely to report a decrease in their handicap than are elderly hearing-impaired subjects who are low in task- orientation.
task-oriented subjects were less handicapped by their hearing impairment than were less task-oriented subjects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use this information to improve hearing aids.
the hearing aids are effective for the elderly people and the elderly people should not be discouraged to wear hearing aids.
